name: partnexa
description: PartNexa — Circular E-Commerce Platform for Vehicle Spare Parts & Services

scripts.build: cd frontend/customer && npm install && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: cd frontend/customer && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/customer"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend/customer && npm install --prefix frontend/shop && npm install --prefix frontend/delivery && npm install --prefix frontend/admin
